source: Editable community-style MVP ranking; verify against the target game version and preferred playstyle.

entries.name: AK17
entries.reason: Excellent damage, stability, and flexible loud-build performance. It is a strong general-purpose primary.

entries.name: Minigun
entries.reason: Very niche: high sustained fire does not compensate for poor mobility, concealment, and build flexibility in most heists.

entries.name: Rami Suppressor
entries.reason: Strong stealth utility when concealment and threat control matter, especially on compact weapons.

entries.name: Explosive Ammunition
entries.reason: Niche utility: valuable for crowd control and shields, but its tradeoffs make it weaker as a universal choice.

entries.name: Joker
entries.reason: Converts an enemy into a durable ally and creates strong tempo and survivability value for the crew.

entries.name: Joker
entries.reason: The aced version extends the value of controlled enemies and is a premium team-support investment when the build can afford it.

entries.name: Scavenger
entries.reason: Improves ammunition pickup consistency and supports aggressive builds that depend on continuous fire.

entries.name: Scavenger
entries.reason: The aced version makes ammo sustain more reliable and is especially valuable for high-RPM weapons.

entries.name: Messiah
entries.reason: Highly conditional recovery value and a steep opportunity cost make it unreliable for most builds.

entries.name: Messiah
entries.reason: The aced version remains highly situational and depends on a narrow recovery scenario rather than improving the core game plan.
